home.tip1: Place a single leaf on a clean, contrasting surface or hold steady in daylight.
home.tip2: Ensure the diseased area or spots are in sharp focus.
home.tip3: Avoid heavy shadows or direct harsh camera flash.

qualityErrors.blurry: Image is too blurry (Laplacian variance: {{val}}). Please hold camera steady and retake.
qualityErrors.dark: Image is too dark (Luminance: {{val}}). Please move to sunlight or brighten.

scan.healthyDesc: Your crop shows no apparent signs of fungal or bacterial infection. Keep up good agronomic care!

scan.unableToIdentifyDesc: Prediction confidence is below 60%. Please take a clearer photo closer to the affected leaf in good lighting or inspect multiple leaves before applying chemicals.
scan.imageRejectedTitle: Image Rejected: Please Upload a Clearer Photo
scan.imageRejectedDesc: Our image quality check detected an issue with the photo. Unsuitable images are rejected to prevent inaccurate disease diagnosis.
